title: Local Resource Finder
description: A full-stack, map-based app for discovering local resources near you. It uses geolocation with a manual search fallback, PostGIS geospatial queries, JWT authentication with role-based access, one-review-per-user ratings, and an admin moderation workflow.

title: HenryTomz Foodstuff Hub
description: An online storefront for a foodstuff retailer in Kaduna. The owner updates prices from a Google Sheet on a phone, so changes go live without touching code. Customers browse the market board, add quantities to a basket and send the order to the shop on WhatsApp.

title: Bluestock Fintech Capstone
description: A fintech platform interface for presenting financial data, with analytics views and interactive forms. It includes a B2B registration flow where accounts are approved from an admin dashboard, and a separate demo request form.

title: Internship Tracker
description: A dashboard that helps applicants track internship applications, interview stages and status updates. Applications are stored in MongoDB, can be filtered by status, and the layout works on mobile.

title: Shiptivitas Logistics Kanban
description: Completed a full-stack engineering simulation for a YC-backed startup. Frontend: drag-and-drop task reordering. Backend: a Node.js persistence layer that syncs board state with a database. Data: used SQL to analyze user activity and proposed feature growth hypotheses.

title: Automatic Security Light Control System
description: An automated hardware solution using LDR sensors and relay logic to reduce energy consumption. Demonstrates foundational algorithmic thinking and system design.
